steps.name: Requirement
steps.description: Turns the raw spec into a testable requirement: feature, scope summary, acceptance criteria (each traceable to the spec's own words), out-of-scope list. Single structured call, no tools. Must not invent scope.

steps.name: Architecture
steps.description: Read-only (Read/Grep/Glob). Verifies paths in the real repo, decides change_required, names files_to_modify/create/delete, and writes the work order (objective, boundaries, definition_of_done) plus a component-level design. Never invents an existing contract.

steps.name: Quality / TDD
steps.description: Reads existing tests to match conventions, then writes tests for the acceptance criteria BEFORE any implementation. Write access only to test-shaped paths. Writing nothing is valid if existing tests already cover it.

steps.name: Coding
steps.description: Implements the plan. Read, plus Write/Edit only on the files Architecture named; custom delete_file (only files_to_delete) and run_tests self-check. Never edits tests. Smallest change that satisfies the plan.

steps.name: Testing
steps.description: Deterministic test run in an isolated venv, then one LLM call that writes the scorecard and GO / NO_GO. A non-passing run is forced to NO_GO in code. Routing is mechanical: pass+change goes to review, fail goes to failure analysis, pass+no change finalizes.

steps.name: Failure Analysis
steps.description: Read-only (Read/Grep/Glob). Diagnoses which artifact is at fault: APPLICATION_DEFECT, TEST_DEFECT, CONTRACT_MISMATCH, SYNTAX_ERROR, ENVIRONMENT_ERROR. Routes to coding, quality, architecture or finalize. May name dependency_fix_files for Coding.

steps.name: Code Review
steps.description: Read-only plus the precomputed diff. Is the code correct, safe and in scope? Findings are BLOCKING or FOLLOW_UP and only real defects. Code forces BLOCKING for hardcoded secrets (Semgrep), known CVEs (pip-audit, only when a manifest changed) and undeclared changed files.

steps.name: QA Review
steps.description: Read-only. Does the test evidence PROVE each acceptance criterion (C1..Cn) is met? Marks each COVERED / PARTIAL / UNCOVERED, checks definition_of_done and weak or vacuous tests. Code forces UNCOVERED or unassessed criteria to BLOCKING.

steps.name: Release Planning
steps.description: No tools. Produces the release plan (title, summary, deployment steps, rollout, monitoring, rollback), feedback for the next cycle, and Jira/Confluence-shaped summaries. Reachable only after BOTH reviews PASS.

steps.name: Release Apply
steps.description: Mechanical, no agent: commit, push (fork fallback if no write access), open the PR, write the issue and wiki records.

steps.name: Finalize
steps.description: Derives the run outcome in code (APPROVED_RELEASED, NO_CHANGE_VERIFIED, REVIEW_BLOCKED, QA_BLOCKED, STAGNANT, EXHAUSTED_ITERATIONS, ...) and appends the run to the cross-run feedback log.
